Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t “weaker than men”—olives don’t have physical strength, and strength varies widely among individual people regardless of gender.

If you mean nutrition, black olives are generally softer because they’re fully ripe and cured, while green olives are harvested earlier and tend to be firmer and more bitter.
